parsed.claim: For every countable discrete group G, the identity star-algebra equivalence of its group von Neumann algebra is a normal, trace-preserving equivalence. So TracialGroupFactorEquiv, and hence TracialGroupFactorsIsomorphic, has an instance for every G.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_refl_factor_equiv (G : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup.{0}) :
    ConnesRigidity.TracialGroupFactorsIsomorphic G G := by
  let e : ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G :=
    StarAlgEquiv.refl (R := ℂ) (A := ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G)
  have h1 : ∀ S : Set (ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G), e '' S = S := by
    intro S; ext x; simp [e]
  have h2 : ∀ S : Set (ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G), e.symm '' S = S := by
    intro S; ext x; simp [e]
  have h3 : ∀ p : ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G, e p = p := fun p => rfl
  have h4 : ∀ p : ConnesRigidity.GroupVonNeumannAlgebra G, e.symm p = p := fun p => rfl
  refine ⟨{ toStarAlgEquiv := e, normal := ?_, trace_preserving := fun x => rfl }⟩
  constructor
  · intro S p h
    rw [h1, h3]; exact h
  · intro S p h
    rw [h2, h4]; exact h
